# Color. Design. Innovation. Introducing our new era of expression and possibilities.
April 29, 2026
Today, Motorola revealed a bold set of announcements that showcase how design, innovation, and personalization continue to shape our product portfolio. From the newest additions to the motorola razr family and the latest Motorola Brilliant Collection to the debut of the motorola edge 70 pro, each device is designed to elevate self‑expression and everyday experiences.
Explore more details on each announcement at the links below.
#### new razr family
[![](https://motorolanews.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/razr-landing-page-scaled.png)](https://motorolanews.com/power-style-and-flexibility-motorola-introduces-three-new-flip-devices-to-the-razr-family)
[![](https://motorolanews.com/color-design-innovation-introducing-our-new-era-of-expression-and-possibilities/)](https://motorolanews.com/motorola-and-google-announce-two-new-google-photos-features-with-the-launch-of-the-new-razr)
#### motorola edge 70 pro
[![](https://motorolanews.com/color-design-innovation-introducing-our-new-era-of-expression-and-possibilities/)](https://motorolanews.com/motorola-unveils-the-sleek-and-fashionable-motorola-edge-70-pro-and-new-collections-by-motorola-design-approach)
#### The Brilliant Collection
[![](https://motorolanews.com/color-design-innovation-introducing-our-new-era-of-expression-and-possibilities/)](https://motorolanews.com/motorola-announces-new-additions-to-the-brilliant-collection-the-motorola-signature-and-moto-buds-2-plus-featuring-crystals-by-swarovski-that-turns-technology-into-jewelry)
